subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` plus `computerUseProviderMetadata` as the public metadata-only Computer Use manifest contract with this field shape and permission semantics?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but it freezes public plugin API surface and is intended to inform host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after docs and boundary confirmation
options.body: Regenerate the docs map, use a rebased branch, and merge after owners confirm host code will use the metadata only as pre-runtime discovery data.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow the fields, platform shape, permission enum, or MCP metadata before publishing the plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep the work draft until the macOS host binding model is settled enough to publish this manifest surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after docs and boundary confirmation
recommendation.body: Regenerate the docs map, use a rebased branch, and merge after owners confirm host code will use the metadata only as pre-runtime discovery data.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed ownership of the plugin manifest/docs surface and also opened the newer rebased candidate branch.
